identity.title: Move Sample Picker image preview decoding to the existing image factory

origin.summary: The user requested that refactoring continue after the documented audit and asked whether the schedule is active.

state.current_summary: PL-0030은 Sample Picker preview decoding을 기존 OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory로 이동하는 구조 변경과 최종 검증을 완료했다. ViewModel의 직접 File.Exists/BitmapImage/OnLoad/DecodePixelWidth coupling은 제거되었고 SelectedImageSource binding, 420px preview, missing/corrupt null, frozen lifetime은 유지되었다. Debug/Release contract와 solution/Smoke build, RefactorAudit, Readiness, DocumentationIndex, issue-ledger, diff check가 통과했다. 전체 WPF/hardware/native 행렬은 미검증으로 기록했다.

objective.summary: Move Sample Picker path-backed preview decoding from the ViewModel to the existing concrete image preview factory without changing the binding contract or preview behavior.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Reuse OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory; do not add a new interface, manager, wrapper, registry, or Partial.
Preserve SelectedImageSource, missing/corrupt-path null behavior, 420-pixel decode width, OnLoad cache, and frozen ImageSource semantics.
Keep all evidence and generated test output on D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not create or reactivate a recurring schedule for this bounded slice.

criteria.text: The report records the current and intended owner, caller path, dependency direction, mutable state writer, lifetime owner, and preserved binding contract.

OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory owns the path-backed Sample Picker preview decode and OpenVisionWorkspaceSamplePickerViewModel no longer performs File.Exists or BitmapImage construction for SelectedImageSource; missing/corrupt paths still return null and valid previews remain OnLoad/frozen with 420-pixel decode width.

A focused source contract, relevant Debug build, documentation index, issue-ledger validation, and targeted git diff check pass, while full WPF theme/DPI/input/monitor and hardware boundaries remain explicitly unverified.

milestones.summary: Freeze the Sample Picker preview owner and call-path proof.
Move preview path decoding to the existing concrete image factory.
Run focused proof, build, documentation, ledger, and diff checks.

evidence.observation: The proof report records the old and new owners, binding call path, selectedSample state writer, factory OnLoad/frozen lifetime, preserved SelectedImageSource contract, and absence of direct File.Exists/BitmapImage decode policy in the Sample Picker ViewModel.

WorkspaceSamplePickerImageBoundaryContract passed 6/6: old coupling absence, existing factory ownership, binding facade preservation, valid frozen preview, missing-path null, and corrupt-path null. VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

Debug/Release focused contracts passed 6/6, Smoke and solution builds passed with 0 warnings/errors, RefactorAudit passed with 54 Partial declarations and 0 project cycles, Readiness Debug/Release passed, DocumentationIndex reported IndexedPaths=299/Routes=17/RootRedirects=102, and targeted diff plus PL-0030 ledger validation passed.

events.summary: Sample Picker preview decode는 새 service가 아니라 기존 OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory로 이동한다. ViewModel의 SelectedImageSource facade와 null/420px/frozen semantics를 보존하고, factory에 optional TryCreateFromPath entry point만 추가한다.

PL-0030의 M1 owner proof, M2 existing factory extraction, M3 final proof를 닫는다. 구조적으로 직접 ViewModel I/O가 제거되었고, 새 추상화 없이 기존 factory를 재사용했으며, 모든 선언된 focused/build/docs checks가 통과했다. 미검증 UI/hardware/legal 행렬은 범위 밖 증거로 남긴다.
PL-0030의 세 completion criteria와 세 milestone이 모두 current evidence로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 동일 owner는 새 defect, requirement, failed criterion, 또는 dependency boundary가 생기기 전에는 다시 열지 않는다.
